entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: White-aligned castle city on Kamigawa, seat of Imperial power.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: Daimyo whose seat of power was Eiganjo.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: Great Serpent who attacked Eiganjo to recover his stolen offspring.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Stole That Which Was Taken and carried it to safety.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Guardian spirit of Kamigawa whose main shrine is in Eiganjo's palace.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which Eiganjo was destroyed.

events.summary: O-Kagachi manifests and attacks Eiganjo to recover his stolen offspring, reducing it to rubble.
events.quote: Eiganjo was reduced to rubble by the wrath of The Great Serpent.

events.summary: Toshiro Umezawa steals That Which Was Taken and carries it to safety.
events.quote: That Which was Taken was stolen by Toshiro Umezawa and transported to safety

events.summary: Eiganjo is rebuilt on the bones of its former castle.
events.quote: Eiganjo was rebuilt upon the bones of its ancient former castle self

relations.note: Eiganjo was the seat of his power as daimyo.
relations.quote: it was the seat of power of daimyo Takeshi Konda
